paragraphs: R. Yudan of Galila: R. Yochanan was his son. [Tanchuma, Acharei Mot 3:1, names R. Yochanan bar Yudan of Galila. The parallel opening in Tanchuma Buber and Rabbah is attributed to Yudan of Galaya.]
